items.markdown:
Biotin (vitamin B7) only promotes hair growth if you have a **true biotin deficiency** , which is rare in people who eat a balanced diet.[[1]](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/is-biotin-as-good-as-advertised-for-your-hair-loss)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/ph4vXrxtP98)

- **Keratin Production:** Biotin acts as a cofactor that helps the body process nutrients and produce keratin, the structural protein that makes up hair, skin, and nails.[[1]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5582478/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Luwif-VNUcM&t=40)
- **Deficiency vs. Growth:** While a deficiency can lead to hair thinning and hair loss, taking extra biotin when your levels are already normal does not speed up hair growth or stop common hair loss conditions like male- or female-pattern baldness.[[1]](https://blog.walgreens.com/wellness/vitamins-supplements/biotin-for-hair-growth-can-it-help.html)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/ph4vXrxtP98)

### Recommended Intake & Food Sources

- **Daily Need:** The adequate intake for adult biotin is **30 mcg per day** , and a standard balanced diet naturally provides **35 to 70 mcg per day**.
- **Food Sources:** You can get plenty of biotin from eggs, fish, meat, dairy, nuts, seeds, and sweet potatoes.[[1]](https://blog-dev.walgreens.com/wellness/vitamins-supplements/biotin-for-hair-growth-can-it-help.html)[[2]](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5582478/)[[3]](https://www.everydayhealth.com/skin-care/does-biotin-help-with-hair-growth-and-loss/)[[4]](https://blog.walgreens.com/wellness/vitamins-supplements/biotin-for-hair-growth-can-it-help.html)

### Risks and Lab Test Interference

- **Lab Testing Issues:** High-dose biotin supplements (often 2,500 to 5,000 mcg or more per pill) do not provide extra hair-growing benefits, but they can severely interfere with medical lab tests—including thyroid panels and cardiac troponin tests (heart attack markers).
- **Washout Period:** Doctors often recommend stopping high-dose biotin 2 to 3 days before getting blood work done.[[1]](https://ascopubs.org/doi/10.1200/OP-25-00693)[[2]](https://www.goodrx.com/conditions/hair-loss/will-taking-biotin-supplements-help-regrow-my-hair)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/ph4vXrxtP98)

- Whether you have **other symptoms** like brittle nails or fatigue
